modules.name: tb_road_postprocess_real_rom
modules.description: Full C2 candidate RAM and C9 FINAL97 simulation through the frozen shared LUT service, using either a controlled true-model word endpoint or one actual PH1P reader.

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.values: Common reset clears head, candidate RAM, NMS, LUT service and endpoint; common cancel preserves an accepted endpoint word until drain.

behavior: Streams exactly 12096 saved 112-bit head words into C2, uses C2's sole internal candidate RAM, and directly connects the sealed/read/response/finish handshakes to C9.

Instantiates the actual frozen road_shared_lut_service; a simulation-only 7168-word true G10 physical image backs exactly one pending word request. Compares every accepted FINAL97 entry to existing frozen vectors.
Measures start-to-seal, seal-to-last-entry/done, start-to-last-entry/done, C2 phase counters, and mutually exclusive C9 phase occupancy with true stall subcounts.
Reports adapter accept-to-response-handshake latency, physical word accepted/consumed counts and request/response wait counters. Function and shared total 2000000-cycle budget are separate outcomes.

USE_VENDOR_ROM excludes the controlled image array and response process, instantiates one unchanged road_numeric_rom_reader with 56 PH1P lanes, and applies symmetric external handshake gates for random stalls. Common cancel never resets the real reader.
constraints: The checker may store expected FINAL97 words but does not instantiate a second functional candidate RAM.
This testbench does not include the production C8 collector, CNN inference, synthesis, timing closure, bitstream, board, or Flash operations.
One shared 2000000-cycle total start-accept to done budget covers scan/TopK/decode/ROM waits/NMS; report budget failure independently of functional correctness.
corner_cases: empty table, inclusive threshold, cross-class identical boxes, same-class suppression, 128 candidates per class, 64 outputs, 992 and 6944 NMS comparisons
random input/LUT/output stalls, at least 128 cycles of output backpressure, consecutive real then empty frames
reset in scan/sort/decode/NMS multiply/held output and response error after an accepted entry followed by cancel and full rerun

Cancel after accepted ROM request retains endpoint ownership, drains exactly one old word and restarts a new frame; common reset flushes accepted read; controlled reader fault during owned LUT query requires common reset.
verification_cases: Seven saved head streams in normal/random modes, original eight recovery/edge runs, plus accepted-ROM cancel, reset and controlled-fault recovery: 25 controlled runs.
Every successful run checks all FINAL97 entries, frame token, counts, finish readiness, stable held handshakes, seal-time RAM write freeze, and the 2000000-cycle postprocess allowance.
The actual PH1P mode runs 24 cases: original 22 plus accepted-ROM cancel and reset recovery; controlled ROM fault injection is excluded. Vendor warnings remain a separate unresolved status.

timing_diagrams.title: Accepted ROM read cancellation and drain
timing_diagrams.description: At the rising edge with cancel high, the accepted word retains endpoint ownership. The late word is consumed in drain before a fresh LUT request can be accepted.
